title: 4A Full Adhesive Sticky Notes, 3 x 3 Inches, 5 Assorted Colors, 5 Pads, 80 Sheets per Pad, 400 Sheets Total
bullets: 5 pads, 400 sheets total: Includes 5 assorted-color pads with 80 sheets per pad. Each square note measures 3 x 3 inches.
Full-adhesive design with a lifting edge: A wide adhesive area covers the back, with a non-stick edge to help separate one sheet from the pad.
Five distinct colors: Lime, peach, orange, pink and yellow help organize subjects, tasks and reminders by color. This pack contains the five colors shown.
Write, lift and place: Start at the non-stick edge and separate one sheet gently. Apply to a clean, dry surface and test delicate finishes or printed pages before use.

For notes and color coding: Use the square paper notes for reminders, study annotations, sorting and everyday planning at home, school or the office. Pens and other scene accessories are not included.
description: Organize everyday notes with 4A full-adhesive sticky notes. This pack contains five 3 x 3 inch pads in lime, peach, orange, pink and yellow. Each pad has 80 sheets, giving you 400 sheets total. The back has a wide adhesive area and a non-stick lifting edge for separating sheets. Use the colors to group tasks, study notes and reminders; test delicate surfaces and printed pages before applying.
